patch_description: Replace the random point placement with a proper continuous optimizer: initialize 14 points on a unit sphere (with symmetry to avoid degenerate starts), then run projected gradient ascent maximizing a soft-minimum of the pairwise distances, rescaling each iteration so dmax = 1. Since the objective dmin/dmax is scale invariant, fixing dmax = 1 and maximizing the (soft) minimum distance directly optimizes the ratio. A softmin (log-sum-exp) gives smooth gradients everywhere, and a final fine-tuning pass with a small temperature sharpens the true minimum. This is a standard relaxation approach for Tammes/packing problems and should reach a squared ratio near the known reference (~1/4.17).
